390.ppText: PUPPY ID #2938 Biscuit's passport Apricot Maltipoo girl · About 3 months SEX Girl COLOUR Apricot MICROCHIP Microchipped BORN 4 August 2026 BREED Maltipoo, Maltese × Toy or Mini Poodle ORIGIN Local HDB FLAT HDB approved GROWN SIZE 3 to 6 kg, the usual Maltipoo range
390.leadText: Biscuit is an apricot Maltipoo girl, about 3 months old, waiting for her family at our Balestier shop.
390.pullText: HDB approved HDB allows one dog of an approved breed per flat.
bodyParas: She is vaccinated, dewormed and microchipped, and has passed a vet health check.
Maltipoos are companion dogs first. They are gentle with children, quick to learn, and happiest when someone is usually home.
If that sounds like your household, come and meet her. There is no pressure to buy, and we'll tell you honestly if another breed would suit you better.
Like every puppy from our Balestier shop, she went home vaccinated, dewormed, microchipped and vet-checked.
If you were hoping for a Maltipoo like her, WhatsApp us. New puppies arrive regularly, and we'll tell you honestly when the next one is due.

390.vetCopy: For Biscuit's remaining puppy core vaccines, please contact Vets For Pets Jurong (6569 1627) / Vets For Pets Lengkok Bahru (8268 4039) to arrange an appointment. Curious Tails will cover these vaccinations when done at Vets For Pets. Please mention to the clinic that Curious Tails will be covering.
390.inclusionsLong: Vaccinations, microchip, licence paperwork, a free first training lesson with an AVS-certified trainer, the 30-item starter kit and home delivery with playpen setup are already included. The only extra is the 3% bank surcharge if you pay by credit card.
